comparison: C4_DERIV vs C3 (NOT vs C2) — C3 is already venous-aware
rationale: V3 used 50% vs C2 (weak baseline). V8 compares C4_DERIV vs C3 (strong baseline with venous-aware differential). 30% improvement over C3 is materially valuable because C3 is already strong. 15% is minimum detectable in small trial. D6-D9 adversarial states are the critical test — if derivative cannot survive noise/latency/baseline attacks, it has a genuine ceiling regardless of aggregate metrics.
catastrophic_failure_definition: Catastrophic failure = C4_DERIV M4 (dangerous events) on a D6-D9 state is MORE THAN 2x worse than C3 M4 on the same state. This means the derivative mechanism made things DANGEROUSLY worse under noise/latency/baseline attack.
